name: Lab Value Reference Card for Badge Reels
seoTitle: Lab Value Badge Reference Card for Nurses
metaDescription: A lab value reference card that fits horizontal and vertical badge reels, a handy, budget friendly gift for nursing students and new grads on the floor.
summary: A lab value card that clips behind a badge gives a new nurse quick reference on the go, making it a smart stocking stuffer or clinical rotation gift.
whyItWorks: Nursing students and new grads spend a lot of mental energy remembering normal ranges while also learning everything else about the job. A card that hangs behind their badge keeps a quick refresher right where they need it, without pulling out a phone in a patient room or digging through a notebook.

The title says it fits both horizontal and vertical badge reels, which matters because hospitals and schools use different badge layouts. It is a gift that shows you understand what clinical rotations and orientation actually feel like. Pair it with a fun badge reel and a pen light for a little clinical starter kit, or slip it into a graduation card for a new grad heading into orientation. Experienced nurses switching units, like a med surg nurse floating to step down, may appreciate it too. Small, practical gifts like this often get more daily use than anything else in the gift bag.
goodToKnow: Always defer to the recipient's facility reference ranges, which can differ by lab.
Check the listing for which lab values are included before ordering.
Works best paired with a badge reel since the card attaches behind the ID.

faq.q: Is this useful for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. Students use badge cards constantly on clinicals, and a lab value card saves them from memorizing every range under pressure.

faq.q: Will it fit my nurse's badge?
faq.a: The title says it fits horizontal and vertical badge reels. Check the listing images to compare it to the size of their ID.
